contract: interface C2 v1 (+ extra variants documented in embed/CONTRACT.md)

conventions.embedding: pooled, L2-normalised float32 (__raw.npy); all geometry in float64
conventions.mean: abtt-ref: reference-set mean; abtt-item/center/nuis: mean over the target item set
conventions.scale: every representation re-normalised to unit rows; S = cosine Gram, unit diagonal, float64
conventions.wording_variants: files for <itemset>.<variant> exist only for variants in WORDING_REPS

all-mpnet-base-v2.dtype_compute: float32 (weights upcast at load; Qwen3 ships bfloat16)
all-mpnet-base-v2.family: MPNet-base encoder (permuted LM pretraining; SBERT 1B-pair contrastive fine-tune)

bge-large-en-v1.5.dtype_compute: float32 (weights upcast at load; Qwen3 ships bfloat16)

qwen3-embedding-0.6b.dtype_compute: float32 (weights upcast at load; Qwen3 ships bfloat16)
qwen3-embedding-0.6b.family: Qwen3 decoder-only LLM (causal attention) embedding fine-tune
